not_applicable.body: This question did not execute. Gate reason: {gate_reason} (for example: first-time clinical status, schizophrenia not confirmed, persistent symptoms not documented, or two adequate suboptimal trials with different drugs not documented). No CPTs were estimated, no posterior exists, and nothing here is a negative treatment-resistance finding or a recommendation against clozapine for other indications. A first-time case skipped here receives no clozapine posterior at all. Clozapine may still be relevant under another question (for example high-suicide R4 or aggression R6) or per direct clinical judgment. This package is distinct from the follow-up no-improvement package F5, which has its own gate and network identity.

description: Predefined physician-review wording for established-case clozapine R7. The LLM never supplies this text; the app renders the matching branch deterministically from stored posteriors, evidence, and missingness. All slots are escaped at render time. No branch prescribes, doses, restarts, continues, stops, or clears clozapine, and no posterior is a diagnosis or a treatment-resistance certification. This template is distinct from the F5 no-improvement follow-up template, which has its own network and branch vocabulary.

conditions.text: URGENT recorded finding: suspected severe neutropenia, myocarditis/NMS, severe or unresolved constipation, or acute psychiatric danger is recorded. Seek immediate senior/emergency evaluation per local safety protocol. Do not await model output; the clozapine discussion follows only after immediate safety is addressed.

deterministic_urgent_flag.otherwise: No deterministic urgent flag fires. An Absent urgent assessment does not certify safety; the posterior branch above still requires physician review.
deterministic_urgent_flag.rule: Rendered directly from saved inputs WITHOUT waiting for any LLM request, inference result, or template posterior. Shown alongside (never replaced by) the posterior branch.

mapping_rule: Render the branch matching the highest-posterior TreatmentResistanceClozapineReviewPathway state ONLY as a review prompt; the posterior maximum is not a treatment recommendation and the physician may choose any course. Always show the TRS-review, adequacy, research-feature, and preparation posteriors alongside the pathway branch. Always evaluate deterministic_urgent_flag from saved inputs first. Always append unknown_disclosure. False gate renders not_applicable; unknown required gate renders needs_clarification.
unknown_disclosure: Inputs recorded as unavailable: {unknown_fields_or_none}. Unavailable is not a negative finding; clarify as clinically indicated. Optional gaps (12-week duration, severity/function features, willingness, monitoring plan, medical review) leave their nodes without hard evidence; required gaps stop the question for clarification.
